# Einstieg

## Ziele

- PHBern slide types distinguish instructional intent.
- Speaker notes separate facilitation from visible content.
- Bundled illustrations support consistent visual language.

::: {.notes}
Briefly explain that the examples mirror recurring patterns in PPD_1 and
PPD_2. Open speaker view with the S key.
:::

## Diskussion {.uebung}

- Which design choice supports learning?
- Which choice is merely decorative?
- What evidence would help decide?

# Wissenschaftliche Einordnung

<!-- `.science` creates the science-slide treatment. -->
## Multimedia Learning {.science}

Multimedia learning is not the accumulation of media. Text, image, and
explanation should support the learner's selection, organization, and
integration of information [@mayer2021].

## Kernaussage

::: {.center-quote}
Gestaltung folgt der didaktischen Absicht.
:::

## Schrittweise Argumentation

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="1"}
First identify the learning objective.
:::

::: {.fragment .center-quote data-fragment-index="2"}
Then choose the smallest useful media combination.
:::

::: {.notes}
Advance once for the first statement and a second time for the centred
quotation.
:::

## {.pause}

# Transfer

## Source and automatic slides

The [source of this example deck](https://github.com/PHBern-RConrardy/phbern-is1/blob/main/examples/slides.qmd)
contains comments beside each PHBern-specific pattern.

The format appends **Rechtliches** and **Literatur** automatically. Add
citations such as [@mayer2021], but do not add headings for these final slides.

## Nächster Schritt {.uebung}

Adapt one slide from your own deck:

1. give it a semantic purpose;
2. reduce visible text;
3. add useful speaker notes;
4. provide alternative text for images.
